abilities.name: Just a Minion
abilities.text: A minion is defeated upon suffering any amount of Damage.

abilities.name: Darkseid Is
abilities.text: When defeated, its body explodes, dealing 1d6 energy damage to all Adjacent.

abilities.name: Relentless Strength
abilities.text: The Brute's first Damage roll in a Turn is made with Advantage.

abilities.name: Tactical Movement
abilities.text: At the beginning of its turn, the General may move 1 ally by 1 Distance.

abilities.name: Relentless Strength
abilities.text: The Brute's first Damage roll in a Turn is made with Advantage.

abilities.name: Harden
abilities.text: May spend 1 Resolve to increase its Damage Reduction by +1 per Round.

name: Captain Boomerang
powers: Marksman 3 (Favorite Weapon, Special Ammunition, Ricochet Shot, Improved Special Ammunition)

abilities.name: Villain
abilities.text: Gains 1 Action (not counting toward the Round's action total) at the end of each Hero's Turn.

abilities.name: Guaranteed Return
abilities.text: Once per Round, when he misses an Attack, at the end of the turn he may re-attack the same target, dealing half Damage on a hit.

description: A sarcastic, opportunistic mercenary and excellent marksman with a lethal arsenal of trick boomerangs. Predictable in negotiations and easily destabilized by a good taunt.

name: Talon
powers: Martial Master 3 (Acrobatic Fighter, Precise Strike, Fists of Steel, Body Fortification)
Swordsman 2 (Precise Attack, Sudden Charge, Barrage of Blows)

abilities.name: Villain
abilities.text: Gains +1 Action (not counting toward the total) at the end of each Hero's turn.

abilities.name: Gift from the Court
abilities.text: At the start of the Round, choose one piece of Gear from the Equipment list; use it once until end of Round.

abilities.name: Shadow Strike
abilities.text: When hidden in shadows, gains +1 die on Damage rolls.

description: An elite, resurrected assassin of the Court of Owls — a silent killer, skilled fighter and relentless tracker.

name: Captain Cold
powers: Marksman 3 (Favorite Weapon, Ricochet Shot, Instinctive Shooter, Barrage of Shots)
equipment: Cold Gun (grants Energy Blast and Elemental Manipulation while wielded)

abilities.name: Villain
abilities.text: Gains 1 Action (not counting toward the Round limit) at the end of each Hero's turn.

abilities.name: All Part of the Plan
abilities.text: Once per Scene, when targeted, declare it was all part of the plan to negate the incoming hit.

abilities.name: Cold Aura
abilities.text: +2 Defense (already included) and half damage from cold attacks.

abilities.name: Ice Age
abilities.text: Once per Campaign, destroy the Cold Gun to absorb its powers, becoming a Meta-Human with +4 Defense and 15 Resolve — a Tier B threat.

abilities.name: Practical Knowledge
abilities.text: At the start of the Scene, choose one ability from a Knowledge to have until the Scene ends.

abilities.name: Speedster Hunter
abilities.text: Deals +1 Damage Die to characters with the Speed Force.

description: A brilliant, methodical criminal whose Cold Gun grants a suite of ice-manipulation abilities — but he is entirely dependent on it.

name: Robin (Damian Wayne)
powers: Swordsman G2 (Singular Weapon [Katana], Precise Strike, Violent Attack, Parry Blow)
Martial Master G2 (Acrobatic Fighter, Precise Strike, Acrobatic Kicks)

archetypeSkills.name: Dirty Boxing
archetypeSkills.text: Once per Round, when you hit, spend 2 Resolve and an Action to deal +2 Damage per Tier.

archetypeSkills.name: I Follow Other Rules
archetypeSkills.text: Once per Issue, when you do something morally questionable, use one of the Editor's Editorial Points as if it were a Plot Point.

limitations.name: Bad Reputation
limitations.text: In Rescue scenes, the Resolve cost of abilities increases by 2.

limitations.name: Paranoia
limitations.text: Damian distrusts everything and everyone around him.

description: Son of Bruce Wayne and Talia al Ghul, raised as the ultimate weapon of the League of Assassins — arrogant, violent and incredibly skilled, a hero in constant inner conflict. Usable as a pregen Hero.
